findings.evidence: build_logical_statuses accepts selected_tier2_runs={QM3350S17,QM3650S23} with the other two registered as cancelled; no same-q branch-pair validation is applied.
findings.required_resolution: Reject any Tier-2 selection other than exactly LOWER_IDS, exactly UPPER_IDS, or empty when the stop action cancels all four. Validate action/result/selected/cancelled consistency.

findings.evidence: Without any C/MH reference manifests, build_logical_statuses marks all four references reused_valid and terminal and can return all_registered_terminal=true after Tier 1 stops.
findings.required_resolution: A reused reference may be terminal/used only when its registered, qualified manifest is present and validates against the ledger. Missing manifests must remain nonterminal or block finalization.

findings.evidence: A C17 manifest with seed=23, q_main=9999 and eight duplicate M/1500 endpoint rows is accepted and counted as eight observed endpoint units.
findings.required_resolution: Validate every manifest run ID, seed and qMain against its ledger row; require exactly the unique Cartesian set {M,R,U,X} x {1500,2700}, coverage eligibility, and registered manifest hashes before counting evidence.

findings.scope: R passage and FCD identity coverage
findings.evidence: Two copies of R_flow.0 in the same FCD frame are not counted as a duplicate; the fixture is classified clear_passage rather than unresolved.
findings.required_resolution: Detect duplicate vehicle identity within each timestep, expose its count, include zero duplicates in coverage_complete, and make any duplicate unresolved.
A user-approved launch state must require the exact nonempty authorization quote and the remaining no-pending launch-card fields; the current prohibited state remains valid only with zero starts.

findings.evidence: validate_contract accepts altered exact EJMI margins, E1 period_s=60, and an occupancy_rule changed to summation/density semantics.
findings.required_resolution: Validate the exact registered margins, 30 s period, occupancy arithmetic-mean percentage-point rule, speed contribution-weighted rule and q rule rather than checking only positive margins and detector IDs.

findings.evidence: The current authoritative proposal hash is ec1c243fecece5f77a4f1201c5565592d732c67fb2d1761d0537fee4f5f47b7c, while both contract and ledger retain 042f0dd0b0cb5152b710b8fa9489a577e1732eda6351b8ae92aa5adbf7de54f5 after the authorized status text was updated.
findings.required_resolution: Update the registered proposal hash consistently after the authoritative status update, or hash a clearly identified immutable scientific-registration payload separate from mutable status text; validate it in context before T43.

reference_reconstruction.method: Source-map hashes and archived files were independently read; two E1 lanes were independently combined; FCD frames and identity-bracketed first downstream R events were independently reconstructed without production aggregation, EJMI, or branch helpers.
reference_reconstruction.semantic_note: Stage 4 q uses nVehEntered while the Stage 3 q table used nVehContrib. For C23 A this yields 3192.0 versus the Stage 3 value 3189.6 veh/h. The Stage 4 contract explicitly registers nVehEntered; comparisons must not silently mix the two q definitions.

launch_gate.safe_next_step: simulation_engineer repairs the six findings without changing the registered scientific design; data_analyst reruns this full independent suite on new hashes before scientific review
